summary: Declares the mobile client for six existing reviewed catalog and order-change capabilities after adding their native editor and exact native receipt objects. Server policy, procedures, roles and rollout are unchanged. Also preserves unavailable saved actions in shared snapshots/native notices and refuses guessed receipt routes, including payments lacking their original Order link. Source integration does not certify device acceptance.

Native price + reason editor; receipt opens the exact native Product.

Native SKU/barcode editor preserving omitted vs cleared; receipt opens the exact native Product.
Native available/unavailable choice for the current Store; receipt opens the exact native Product.
